verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents official Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs for tracing any agent stack [langsmith-docs-24]. The official langsmith-sdk repo shows Python instrumentation via wrap_openai [langsmith-gh-1] and native integration with both LangChain Python and LangChain JS [langsmith-gh-3]. Missing for 10: concrete JS/TS SDK instrumentation docs or code examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of the JS/TS SDK.
